English · 简体中文
**Personal-Knowledge-Base is the single maintained repository for the DSH knowledge-base plugin and
standalone desktop client.** They share a core, contracts and library service while retaining indepe
ndent installations and versions.
| Product | Published version | Direct download | Release notes |
| **Desktop client · Windows x64** | **1.1.2** | **⬇ Download client installer (EXE)** | Client Rele

ase |
| **DSH knowledge-base plugin** | **2.5.10** | **⬇ Download plugin (TGZ)** | Plugin Release |
Release entries: client 1.1.2 · plugin 2.5.10. Choose the correct installer/TGZ and verify its produ
ct-specific manifest and digest.
## One library, two entry points
- **Client:** full file tree and path navigation, up to four resizable panes, draggable tabs, Markdo
wn/text/code editing, vertically scrolling selectable PDF, image zoom/pan and limited DOCX/XLSX/CSV

editing.
- **Plugin:** DSH import, retrieval, OCR/ASR, organization workflows, relationships, indexi

ng, backup and existing tool/UI entry points.
- **Shared modules:** text/vector indexing, exclusions
, inbox, relationships, reading/annotations and backup. Authorized shared services coordinate writes

; do not manually duplicate index databases.
- **Connected workspace:** the DSH sidebar provides ses
sions, Agent presets, model/reasoning controls and streamed replies. Users explicitly attach files o

r selected text. Optional memory integration depends on its corresponding host service.
- **Independ
ent operation:** local client file/library functions remain available independently. The plugin reta
ins its DSH entry points. Chat, model organization and host-provided global-memory writes require th
eir services to be online.
## Download and installation
### Desktop client 1.1.2 · Windows x64
**Download KnowledgeWorkbench-1.1.2-Setup.exe** · Release notes and assets · SHA-256 checksums
Run the EXE to install. The bundled-runtime package includes its runtime. This is the standalone cli
ent installer, not a DSH plugin bundle.
### DSH plugin 2.5.10
**Download local-dsh-knowledge-base-2.5.10.tgz** · Release notes and assets
Install the TGZ through DSH plugin management. GitHub highlights only one Latest release, but both p
roducts have independent releases. Use the product links above or browse all Releases.
Source, issues and future releases are maintained here. In Releases, choose the correct product: Win
dows Setup.exe for the client, TGZ for the plugin.
Published plugin 2.5.10: Release · TGZ. See plugin usage and mirror information for extensions and r
egional sources. Mirror availability can vary.
The existing client installer retains its paper-green interface and animations, requires an empty ap
plication directory and preserves personal data on uninstall. Client online checks and verified down
loads are implemented; automatic in-place installation and activation remain unfinished. The plugin
keeps its existing update manifests and installation flow.

## Source layout
`apps/desktop` contains the client. `src` retains plugin adapters and UI paths for compatibility. `p
ackages` owns the shared core, contracts and service. `presets` and `skills` contain DSH configurati
on rules; `installer-design-b` owns installer design/implementation; `website` is the showcase; `doc
s/client` contains client guides; `tools` and `tests` provide build and verification utilities.
## Privacy, evidence and licensing
No personal libraries, conversations, credentials, index databases, runtime configurations, logs or
local test outputs belong in Git. Opening a file does not automatically send it to a model; explicit
attachments and cloud tasks follow provider configuration and authorization.
The merged client passed a production build and focused checks. See the project record for historica
l evidence and limits. Static checks and synthetic services do not establish live-model performance,
cloud availability, full Office fidelity or every DSH-version compatibility.
MIT licensed. Third-party components retain their licenses; see notices.
Update policy: every eligible version in the selected channel updates automatically, including major
s and previews. The client online executor remains unfinished; see version policy.
## 2.4.13: direct 2.4.3 updates and legacy service handoff (2026-11-05)
Restore the stable feed for direct updates from normal 2.4.3 installations. Identify the published l
egacy runtime by its exact fingerprint, release the probe connection and wait for its existing idle
lifecycle to finish. Require matching process identity and a clean receipt before starting the new s
ervice. Never send legacy shutdown or terminate other clients/tasks; timeout offers recovery guidanc
vice. Never send legacy shutdown or terminate other clients/tasks; timeout offers recovery guidance.

### Local update 2.5.1
Flow cards now keep text, execution settings, and actions in separate sections. Save the model and r
easoning effort in the card; Run uses that configuration directly. Only missing required task parame
ters need an extra form.
